page.layout: One printed page with no text: a library stamp in violet ink ("Abgegeben von der Universitäts-Bibliothek München") in the upper middle, and a faint oval stamp below it. Only stamps and stains; nothing transcribable.
page.notes: The violet rectangular stamp reads "Abgegeben / von der / Universitäts- / Bibliothek München" and the faint oval blue stamp below it is illegible. Both are library stamps and are left out of the transcription, as are the stains and the darkened edges of the scan.
